# Bokksu

> > Authentic Japanese snack and candy subscription box service delivering curated monthly boxes featuring regional treats from Hokkaido, Tokyo, Osaka, Okinawa, and beyond.

Bokksu connects subscribers to authentic Japanese food culture through monthly snack boxes, featuring traditional items like mochi, senbei rice crackers, and regional specialties. The service offers themed boxes celebrating Japanese seasons (cherry blossom/sakura), regional cuisines, and cultural traditions with educational content about makers and ingredients.

## Key Topics

- Japanese snacks
- Subscription box service
- Japanese candy and sweets
- Regional specialties (Hokkaido, Tokyo, Osaka, Okinawa)

## Seasonal & Themed Boxes

- [Cherry Blossom Snack Box](https://bokksu.com/pages/march-24-bokksu-cherry-blossom-nights): Special edition Cherry Blossom Nights box with kimono robe gift
- [Fiery Foliage Gifts](https://bokksu.com/pages/bokksu-24-fiery-foliage-gifts): Autumn Hues Awaken box with Japanese maple momiji seasonal theme
- [Japanese Haunted Harvest Snacks](https://bokksu.com/pages/october-19-bokksu-haunted-harvest): October 2019 Haunted Harvest themed box with autumn flavors
- [April Theme: Gluttonous Osaka](https://bokksu.com/blogs/news/april-theme-gluttonous-osaka): April box theme featuring Osaka's food culture and Okonomiyaki

## Japanese Snack Guides

- [Iconic Japanese Snacks from Hokkaido](https://bokksu.com/blogs/news/iconic-japanese-snacks-from-hokkaido): Guide to famous Hokkaido snacks like Shiroi Koibito and regional treats
- [Best Japanese Mochi Snacks 2023](https://bokksu.com/blogs/news/best-japanese-mochi-snacks): Guide to mochi varieties including Matcha Chocolate Daifuku Mochi
- [A Chocolate a Day: Our Favorite Japanese Chocolates](https://bokksu.com/blogs/news/a-chocolate-a-day-our-favorite-japanese-chocolates): Curated list of favorite Japanese chocolate products and brands
- [Flavors of Okinawa](https://bokksu.com/blogs/news/flavors-of-okinawa): Guide to Okinawan ingredients like Kokuto black sugar and purple yams
- [6 Japanese Sweets for Valentine's Day](https://bokksu.com/blogs/news/six-japanese-sweets-for-valentines-day): Japanese Valentine's Day traditions with honmei-choco and White Day

## Japanese Culture & Traditions

- [Bokksu Trends: The Tranquility of Tea Ceremony](https://bokksu.com/blogs/news/bokksu-trends-the-tranquility-of-tea-ceremony): Sado tea ceremony experience at NYC's Setsugekka sanctuary
- [Manga Snacks: How to Enjoy Popular Manga with Bokksu Treats](https://bokksu.com/blogs/news/manga-snacks-to-enjoy): Snack pairings for manga series like One Piece and My Hero Academia
